description: Vacanța România helps you discover verified tourist attractions across Romania: natural sites, castles and fortresses, monasteries and churches, museums, and hiking areas. Ask what to visit in a county or town, what is near you within a chosen radius, or explore by theme — nature, history, culture, lesser-known places. Every result comes with a short description in Romanian or English, the county and locality, coordinates, and a link to the full page on vacantaromania.ro (holidayinromania.com in English), so you can read more, see photos and plan the trip. The data is a curated database of published attractions, kept up to date by the Vacanța România team. No account is needed and nothing about you is stored.
